lines.zh: 我在沙滩上拖着壳慢慢走
lines.en: I drag my shell slowly across the beach.

lines.zh: 海水漫过我的背，我不在意
lines.en: Seawater washes over my back; I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我的尾剑在沙上划出长线
lines.en: My tail spike draws a long line in sand.
Wet sand holds my weight.
I shuffle sideways along the surf line.

lines.zh: 退潮后，礁石都露出来了
lines.en: The tide is out; the rocks stand bare.

lines.zh: 我从浅滩走进更深的水
lines.en: I walk from the shallows into deeper water.

lines.zh: 十只脚一起动，沙沙作响
lines.en: Ten legs move at once, rustling the sand.

lines.zh: 我绕过一片海草，继续前行
lines.en: I skirt a patch of seagrass and go on.
A wave hits and I hold my ground.
Barnacles crowd my shell.
I creep toward the deep, step by step.

lines.zh: 沙地上的脚印很快被浪抹平
lines.en: Waves smooth my tracks away quickly.
Slow, yes, but I never halt.

lines.zh: 涨潮了，我往岸上退了两步
lines.en: The tide is rising, so I back two steps up the shore

lines.zh: 我的螯在沙上拖出两道浅痕
lines.en: My claws drag two shallow lines in the sand
Half buried in sand, I wait for the tide.
A gull lands on my back.
I work my gill covers slowly.

lines.zh: 海水一涨一落，我数得清楚
lines.en: I count each rise and fall of the sea.
A crust of salt dries on my shell.

lines.zh: 我盯着退潮留下的小水洼
lines.en: I watch the pools the ebb left behind.

lines.zh: 有小鱼从我的腿间穿过
lines.en: Small fish slip between my legs.
I say nothing; the sea speaks for me.

lines.zh: 我抖一抖，沙就从壳上落下
lines.en: One shake and the sand slides off.
The water in the pool grows warmer.

lines.zh: 我慢慢闭上眼睛，又睁开
lines.en: I close my eyes slowly, then open them.
The sound of surf covers everything.

lines.zh: 我把尾剑插进沙里支撑
lines.en: I plant my tail spike in the sand.
I have waited on this shore many years.

lines.zh: 你在滩上站着，我被惊动了
lines.en: You stand on my shore; I am disturbed.
The sand under your feet is mine.
I prop my front half up high.

lines.zh: 你带来的味道，把潮水弄浑了
lines.en: Your smell muddies the clean tide.
There is seagrass on your boots.
I have watched longer than you think.

lines.zh: 你退了半步，可潮水还没退
lines.en: You stepped back, but the tide has not.

lines.zh: 你手上那根鱼竿，我看见了
lines.en: I see the fishing rod in your hand.

lines.zh: 你弯腰捡贝壳时，我动了
lines.en: When you stooped for shells, I moved.
This beach is not wide enough for us both.
My shell is cracked, though not deeply.
Your blade struck my shell and glanced away.

lines.zh: 我断了一条腿，剩下九条
lines.en: One leg gone; nine still carry me.
That landed on a joint.

lines.zh: 疼得我把整副壳收紧了
lines.en: The hurt makes me clamp my whole shell.

lines.zh: 我的血是蓝的，你看见了吗
lines.en: My blood is blue; did you see?
Seawater washes the wound and stings.
I hold myself up and do not fall.
The crack in my old shell reopened.
I back into the surf to recover.
That fish in your hand smells strong.
I have eaten far bigger things.
You hold the fish high; I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 我闻到了血，不是海水的
lines.en: I smell blood, and it is not the sea's.
You think one fish buys passage.
At low tide I eat whatever I find.
Wiggle that line and I will follow.
I come closer slowly; do not bolt.
This fish is too thin to matter.

lines.zh: 你把鱼扔下，我就放你走
lines.en: Drop the fish and I let you pass.
You strike my shell like a reef.
I am shoved half a step aside.

lines.zh: 别从后面顶我，我会转身
lines.en: Do not push from behind; I will turn.
My shell's rim scrapes your leg.
We are wedged in the rock gap.

lines.zh: 你踢了我一下，沙子进了鳃
lines.en: You kicked me; sand is in my gills.
Go around; the path is past the water.

lines.zh: 我挪动身体，沙会陷下去
lines.en: When I shift, the sand gives way.
Your weight cannot move me.
Crowd me again and the tail spike answers.

lines.zh: 成对的巨鲎在浅滩相遇
lines.en: Paired horsehoe crabs meet in the shallows.

lines.zh: 我跟着她的气味走了很远
lines.en: I followed her scent a long way.
We touch claws, once.

lines.zh: 潮水会把我们带回同一片滩
lines.en: The tide will bring us to the same shore.
She carries more barnacles than I do.

lines.zh: 配对时，我们挤在一起不动
lines.en: Paired, we press together and stay still.
We two are all that is left of this sea.
Our young will hatch in the sand.

lines.zh: 我守在她身边，直到退潮
lines.en: I stay beside her until the ebb.
More of our kind means a louder shore.

lines.zh: 掉在沙上的东西，我夹一下
lines.en: I pinch whatever drops onto the sand.
I flick shell fragments aside.
The fish you dropped is mine now.
I do not carry things; I eat them.
That bone is too heavy to drag.
Coins in the sand will not crush.
I pinch the scraps into my mouth.
Whatever I pick up is usually rubbish.
I take only what the tide gives.

lines.zh: 我夹起一块海藻，慢慢嚼
lines.en: I lift a bit of kelp and chew slowly.
You have been on my beach too long.

lines.zh: 我听见你踩碎贝壳的声音
lines.en: I hear you crunching shells.
The tide went out, yet you stayed.
I turn my body toward you.

lines.zh: 这片沙滩，今天只容一个
lines.en: Only one of us belongs here today.
Your movement startled the shallows.
I smell that you are bleeding.

lines.zh: 我一直看着你在礁石边翻找
lines.en: I watched you picking among the rocks.

lines.zh: 你已经走进了浪线以内
lines.en: You have stepped inside the surf line.

lines.zh: 我准备好了，尾巴也抬起来了
lines.en: I am ready, and my tail is up.

lines.zh: 我横着走，拦住你的退路
lines.en: I walk sideways and cut off your retreat.
Run to the water and you only come closer.
My eyes sit on your calves.
The surf will push you back to me.

lines.zh: 你的步伐节奏我摸清了
lines.en: I have learned the tempo of your stride.

lines.zh: 我用壳挡住礁石的缺口
lines.en: I plug the gap between the rocks.
You turn; I take half a step.

lines.zh: 沙陷的地方，你会慢下来
lines.en: Where the sand sinks, you will slow.

lines.zh: 我在等潮水到最高的时候
lines.en: I wait for the tide to peak.
You cannot find my eyes.
My tail spike drives into your calf.
I slam my whole shell forward.
My claw closes on your ankle, hard.
You go down on the wet sand.

lines.zh: 这一下，比看起来重得多
lines.en: That hit landed heavier than it looked.

lines.zh: 我用壳边碾过你的脚背
lines.en: I grind my shell's edge across your foot.
Blood mixes into the surf and spreads.

lines.zh: 你挡住了第一下，还有第二下
lines.en: You blocked the first; the second comes.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的裤脚，往回拖
lines.en: I bite your trouser leg and drag.

lines.zh: 退潮前，你走不出这片滩
lines.en: Before the ebb, you will not leave this beach.

lines.zh: 潮水把幼体送到这片滩
lines.en: The tide delivered young to this beach.
I crawl up from the deep onto sand.
The first wave hits and I wake.
Seagrass still hangs from my shell.

lines.zh: 我在这里等了很多个潮
lines.en: I have awaited many tides here.

lines.zh: 沙里还有我上次蜕的壳
lines.en: My last molt still lies in the sand.

lines.zh: 月亮拉高了海水，也带来了我
lines.en: The moon raised the sea, and brought me.
I step onto wet sand into the moonlight.

lines.zh: 这片滩上的巨鲎又多了
lines.en: One more horsehoe crab on this shore.

lines.zh: 我落地的声音，被浪盖住
lines.en: The surf drowns the sound of my landing.

lines.zh: 壳被火烤得发烫，我难受
lines.en: Fire heats my shell until it hurts.

lines.zh: 从礁石上摔下，壳磕掉了角
lines.en: Dropped off a rock and chipped my shell.
Too deep; mud fills my gills.
The blast leaves my shell ringing dully.
An arrow sticks in my shell seam.
Something slips past my shell and in.

lines.zh: 退潮太久了，我饿得发慌
lines.en: The ebb has lasted too long; I am starving.

lines.zh: 海水导电，雷把我打得发麻
lines.en: The sea conducts; lightning leaves me numb.

lines.zh: 水没有了，脚下也没有沙
lines.en: No water, and no sand under me.
